name: The Westin Riverfront Resort & Spa at Beaver Creek Mountain
positioning: The Westin Riverfront Mountain Villas, Beaver Creek Mountain: a villa resort at the base of Beaver Creek Mountain in Avon, steps from the Riverfront Express Gondola, with Spa Anjali and a heated saltwater lap pool
best_for: Skiers who want gondola access to Beaver Creek Mountain
Families and groups who want villas with kitchens and laundry

facts.text: The resort offers studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom villas with furnished balconies or patios.
Villas have a kitchen or kitchenette, washers and dryers, and living spaces.
Two-bedroom villas have two living areas, separate dining spaces, and a kitchen and kitchenette.
The two-bedroom villa sleeps up to eight.
Spa Anjali has a full-service salon.
The Athletic Club at Westin has Technogym and Peloton equipment and offers classes including yoga and Pilates.
Colletta serves modern Italian cuisine with house-made pastas and wood-fired pizzas.
Year-round activities include skiing, hiking, biking, fishing and whitewater rafting.
In summer guests can fly-fish, kayak and raft on the Eagle River.

highlights.text: The Riverfront Express Gondola, steps from the villas, connects Avon to Beaver Creek Mountain.
The resort is at the base of Beaver Creek Mountain.
The resort has a heated 25-yard saltwater lap pool, open year-round, and three infinity hot tubs.
Spa Anjali's treatments draw on Alpine European techniques, Himalayan Ayurvedic practices and Native American healing traditions of the Rocky Mountains.
The Lobby Bar & Lounge looks out over Beaver Creek and the Eagle River.

considerations.text: The property is a vacation ownership resort.
Eagle County Airport is the closest airport, about 35 miles away.
